caption: The drawing depicts a round ceramic plate shown from above and from the side. The plate has a reddish-brown overall tone with a decorative design on its interior. The inner design features a green wavy border, enclosing a central motif with stylized floral elements in green and black, and a heart shape at the base of the floral design containing the numbers “1816” written in black. The rim of the plate is decorated with a pattern of wavy and zigzag lines in alternating light and dark tones, primarily cream and brown. Below the main view of the plate is a side profile of the plate, depicted in shades of brown, showing its shallow depth. The background is a plain beige color. The words “Conew Pottery” are written in cursive at the lower left, outside the plate illustrations.
title: Pa. German Scraffito Plate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
